reason: Evidence shows this plugin is primarily a development-support skill for DSH plugin creators: the README and package metadata define a single `dsh-plugin-boundary` skill focused on documenting supported/unsupported platform capabilities, and the bundle/patch layout wires the skill into DSH.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DSH 插件开发者的技能插件，提供 `dsh-plugin-boundary` 技能，帮助在开发前了解平台能力边界和可支持/不可支持的规则。
summaries.en: This is a DSH skill plugin that exposes a `dsh-plugin-boundary` skill to help plugin developers review platform capability boundaries before implementation.

capabilities: Registers a DSH skill that exposes plugin development boundary guidance
Packages markdown rule documentation as part of the plugin payload
Integrates via DSH bundle patch into the host profile
